description: This file is the main source code for a Flutter application implementing a Tic Tac Toe game with a custom Ocean Professional theme. It includes widget definitions, game logic, UI construction, and theme styling.

classes.name: AppColors
classes.description: Defines the ocean-themed color palette constants for the app.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up the theme and home page for the Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: TicTacToePage
classes.description: Main stateful widget hosting the game UI, handling game state, user interactions, and game logic.

classes.name: _TicTacToePageState
classes.description: State class managing game logic, scoring, user interactions, and rebuilding UI updates.

classes.name: _Header
classes.description: Widget displaying the game title and current game status.

classes.name: _ScoreBar
classes.description: Widget showing current scores for X, O, and draws.

classes.name: _BoardCard
classes.description: Decorative container for the game board with styling.

classes.name: _GameBoard
classes.description: Widget representing the 3x3 grid of the Tic Tac Toe cells.

classes.name: _Cell
classes.description: Widget for individual game cell, showing player mark and handling taps.

classes.name: _Controls
classes.description: Widget with buttons for restarting the game or starting a new match.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; runs the TicTacToeApp.

methods.name: buildOceanTheme
methods.description: Builds and returns the custom ocean-themed ThemeData for the app.

methods.name: newMatch
methods.description: Resets scores and the game board for a new match.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Resets the board for a new round, keeping scores.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles user tap on a cell; updates game state accordingly.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks the board for a win or draw, updates game state.
